acceptance: Unit test with a fake process table: an over-budget process with cwd in a worktree is selected; an over-budget process outside any checkout is never selected; a process in a live holder's tree is skipped unless pressure is critical.

Subprocess test: sentinel in kill mode with a tiny budget terminates a child (cwd in a tmp fake worktree registered via injected worktree list) that allocates above budget, and logs it; warn mode leaves it running.
Log rotation bounds `sentinel.log` size in a unit test.
`make heavy-sentinel-install` / `uninstall` tested against a tmp `LaunchAgents` dir and a stub `launchctl`; real install only per G1.
Smoke: `make heavy-sentinel` in warn mode on this Mac for 30 s reports current BenchBox-rooted processes and footprints without signalling; output recorded.
context: Added after the TODO review's L3 reframe: the incident's trigger process may not have used any guarded entry point. JetsamEvent-2026-10-30-161255.ips: pids 64736-64739 uv/python3.12 chain, ~309 s old, 25.83 GiB.
description:
## Problem
The guard bounds only processes started through compliant entry points. The 25.83 GiB process (pid 64739) sat in a `uv` -> python3.12 -> `uv` -> python3.12 chain; the jetsam report has no command line, so its entry point is unknown. If it was an ad-hoc `uv run`, no lock, admission or watchdog would have stopped it. Orphaned servers started by hand (QuestDB JVMs, ppid 1) are likewise outside every holder's tree.

## Change
1. `python -m benchbox.utils.host_lock sentinel`: one per-user watcher, independent of any lock holder. Every 5 s it reads pressure level and footprints (shared sampler from heavy-guard-watchdog) of processes whose cwd or executable lies inside a BenchBox checkout or linked worktree (resolved from `git worktree list` of the primary clone, refreshed every minute).
2. Breach: a single such process above the budget resolver (50% of RAM), or pressure level >= 2 (warn) while such processes together exceed the budget. Action follows `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG` semantics (default kill: SIGTERM the largest offender, 10 s, SIGKILL; `warn` reports only). Processes in a live lock holder's tree are left to that holder's watchdog unless pressure is critical (4).
3. Log every breach and action to `~/.benchbox/sentinel.log` (rotated, bounded size) and stderr.
4. `make heavy-sentinel` (foreground), plus `make heavy-sentinel-install` / `heavy-sentinel-uninstall` that write/remove a per-user LaunchAgent plist under `~/Library/LaunchAgents/` and load/unload it with `launchctl bootstrap/bootout gui/$UID`.
5. `make heavy-status` shows whether the sentinel is running.

## Decision gates
- D1 (resolved): same budget and kill default as the watchdog; scope limited to processes rooted in BenchBox checkouts so unrelated user apps are never signalled.
- G1 (owner gate): installing the LaunchAgent on this Mac changes host state outside the repo. Implement and test the install target, but run `make heavy-sentinel-install` only with owner approval in the current task; otherwise report the exact command.
- G2 (stop condition): if process cwd cannot be read for same-user processes without elevated rights, scope by executable path and command-line worktree paths only, and record the gap.

## Guardrails (all heavy-guard items)
- Linked worktree from `origin/develop` via `make worktree-create`; never the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; never `git add -A`.
- `[COMMENT-POLICY-001]`: no comments or docstrings in new code. Durations use `benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time()`/`elapsed_seconds()`.
- Tests use `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR` under `tmp_path` and injected readings; never touch the real `~/.benchbox/test.lock` or depend on live host pressure, VMs or disk.
- Never delete, move or recreate a lock file from code; never stop, resize or signal processes/VMs this invocation did not start.
- Keep names `test.lock`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK`, `BENCHBOX_TEST_SESSION_OWNER` (rename deferred on heavy-guard-status-policy).
- No automatic skip on `CI` or `BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE` (agent shells export `CI=true`).
- No heavy verification runs (no benchmark sweeps above scale 0.01, no real compose stacks) unless the item names one.
- Never signal processes outside BenchBox checkouts; never require root.

## Non-goals
Cross-user enforcement; Docker/Apple-container VM processes (launchd children outside any checkout).
